data.announceAlt: Illustration introducing two new Rainbow Circuits mascots: Pounce, a curious purple panther cub, and Penelope, a soft grey chinchilla, side by side.
announceBody: Pip and Puddle are making room on the lilypad, because the family is growing. Meet Pounce, a curious little panther with a nose for adventure and a talent for finding trouble, and Penelope, a gentle chinchilla who keeps the cosy corners warm and reminds everyone to slow down and snack.
You'll be seeing a lot more of these two around the community — in comics, corners, and quite possibly a puzzle or two. Be nice to them; they're new here.
lostAndFound: One frog who insists he was invited
data.comicAlt: A cosy watercolour portrait of all four Rainbow Circuits mascots in a lantern-lit garden by a lilypad pond: Pip the sparrow in a rainbow bandana, Pounce the black panther in round glasses and a starry galaxy bandana with a telescope behind him, Puddle the frog in a rainbow bow tie on a lilypad, and Penelope the chinchilla in a rainbow scarf and satchel holding a mug of cocoa.
data.comicCaption: The whole crew: Pip, Puddle, Pounce and Penelope, together at the clubhouse.

data.intro: Pounce insists on hiding things and Penelope insists we make them into puzzles. Grab a pen (or your keenest eyes) and settle in — solutions will turn up in a future issue, or in the community if you can't wait.

puzzles.title: Where's Penelope?

data.intro: The Gala may be over, but the circuit never really sleeps. Here's what happens around here every week — and every month — with absolutely no pressure to do more than wave.
The first Gala showed us what can happen when this community is given a theme, a little encouragement, and absolutely no adult supervision. Now we want to know what you would like us to create next.

data.message: Thank you for reading Issue #001, for filling a ballroom with art and chaos, and for making the first Rainbow Circuits Gala feel exactly like the community that built it. The Gala will return — this is officially an annual tradition now, no take-backs.
data.contribute: Want your art, writing, or wildly specific opinions in Issue #002? Watch the community for the next call for submissions, or message the mod team any time.
